inherit: protocol05 numerical/controller/log/heading/height/observation/landing gates unchanged; never inherit its budget or authorization
change: POSCTL local trajectory XY hold target -> explicit global COMMAND_INT XY, altitude and once-frozen yaw; not a request to retain an invalid Navigator triplet
source: After existing heading admission, capture raw onboard trajectory_setpoint XY at the latest validated local_position sample, preceding target <=40ms old; original global reference unchanged; no actual-position substitution, no truth

wire.z: float32 AMSL altitude from original ground reference

handoff.before_acceptance: bounded pending joins fresh addressed accepted ACK, AUTO_LOITER and matching post-command Navigator target; intermediate stale/invalid/temporary targets are recorded, never accepted
handoff.after_acceptance: no mode or target loss; error latch and no resend; raw logs must show continuous target from first qualified readback through observation

downstream: Raw Navigator lat/lon equals integer wire /1e7 exactly; float alt/yaw equals wire exactly. CLI compared to pinned 6/4 decimal printing only. During 3s entry/observation local and consumed XY finite and <=0.05m from encoded target, original height/yaw gates retained.
limitations: Offline replay and synthetic target responses do not prove real command-to-Navigator/FlightTask scheduling or flight. Batch capture/seed registration/clean source rebuild and explicit new flight authorization remain necessary. Old failed runs remain failed.
